test_suites.name: Authentication
test_suites.description: Verify user and admin login/register flows.

tests.name: User Registration
tests.expected_result: User created and redirected to login/dashboard.

tests.name: User Login
tests.expected_result: JWT token stored in localStorage and redirected to Dashboard.

tests.name: Admin Login
tests.expected_result: Admin dashboard visible with statistical data.

test_suites.name: Habit Management
test_suites.description: Functional tests for core habit features.

tests.name: Create Habit
tests.action: Add a new habit named 'Read 30 mins'.
tests.expected_result: Habit appears in the list on the dashboard.

tests.name: Toggle Habit Completion
tests.action: Click the completion checkmark for 'Read 30 mins'.
tests.expected_result: Habit status updates to completed, confetti animation triggers.

tests.name: Delete Habit
tests.expected_result: Habit is removed from the dashboard and database.

test_suites.name: Admin Operations
test_suites.description: Verify admin-only features and user management.

tests.name: View Global Stats
tests.action: Check if statistics charts load on Admin Dashboard.
tests.expected_result: Stats charts (Recharts) render with non-zero data (if users exist).

tests.name: Manage Users
tests.action: Create, Edit, and Delete a test user from the admin user list.
tests.expected_result: Administrative CRUD operations reflected in database.

tests.name: Chat Connectivity
tests.action: Send 'Hello' to Karina the AI coach.
tests.expected_result: Received a non-empty string response from the backend.

tests.name: Chat Context
tests.action: Ask 'How can I build better habits?'
tests.expected_result: Response should be relevant and maintain the 'Karina' persona.

tests.name: Glassmorphism Rendering
tests.action: Inspect the dashboard background and card styles.
tests.expected_result: Correct semi-transparent effects and blur applied via CSS.

tests.name: Responsive Layout
tests.action: Check dashboard on mobile screen width (e.g., 375px).
tests.expected_result: Layout adapts without horizontal scrolling or overlapping elements.
